July 31, 2026

We finally took the family to Hawaii — it was everyone’s first time! We had a blast. The Hilton Hawaiian Village is a beautiful resort with all the amenities you could ask for. We were beach front and got plenty of sun time in. We also got to check out Tropical Farms near the North Shore and an amazing Huli Huli chicken place along the way. Can’t wait until the next time!
